SYMPTOM: git stash pop caused merge conflicts; ran git clean -fd to clean up → permanently deleted untracked files including test_audio/ directory and other working files
CAUSE: git clean -fd removes ALL untracked files with no undo/recycle bin. Files like test_audio/ were tracked in old commits but removed from git later, so they were just loose untracked files on disk.
FIX: test_audio/ is recoverable from git history (commit 6cd2641). Any file ever committed can be restored with git checkout <commit> -- <path>.
PREVENT: Before any git clean, run git clean -n first (dry run) to see what would be deleted. Never run git clean -fd to resolve stash conflicts — use git checkout . instead.
